VHS.AdvancedPreviews.name: Advanced Previews
VHS.AdvancedPreviews.tooltip: Automatically transcode previews on request. Required for advanced functionality

VHS.AdvancedPreviewsMinWidth.name: Minimum preview width
VHS.AdvancedPreviewsMinWidth.tooltip: Advanced previews have their resolution downscaled to the node size for performance. While a node can be resized to increase preview quality, a minimum width can be set that previews won't be downscaled beneath. Preveiws will never be upscaled, so this can safely be set large.

VHS.AdvancedPreviewsDeadline.name: Deadline
VHS.AdvancedPreviewsDeadline.tooltip: Determines how much time can be spent when encoding advanced previews. Realtime results in reduced quality, but good will likely cause the preview to stutter as initial generation occurs

VHS.LatentPreviewRate.name: Playback rate override.
VHS.LatentPreviewRate.tooltip: Force a specific frame rate for the playback of latent frames. This should not be confused with the output frame rate and will not match for video models.

VHS.MetadataImage.name: Save png of first frame for metadata

VHS.KeepIntermediate.name: Keep required intermediate files after sucessful execution
